meta.name: modal-serverless-gpu
meta.description: Serverless GPU cloud platform for running ML workloads. Use when you need on-demand GPU access without infrastructure management, deploying ML models as APIs, or running batch jobs with automatic scaling.

copy.tagline: 按需使用GPU运行机器学习工作负载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要GPU跑ML模型但不想管理服务器
copy.tagline_en: Run ML workloads on on-demand GPU without infrastructure management
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need GPU for ML but want to skip server management

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你编写 Python 代码，在 Modal 的无服务器 GPU 平台上运行机器学习任务，比如部署模型为 API、执行批量推理或定时任务，无需管理服务器。
howto.when: 当你需要按需使用 GPU 运行机器学习工作负载，例如部署模型为 API、执行批量处理或定时任务，且不想管理基础设施时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Modal 函数，用 T4 GPU 运行 nvidia-smi。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Python 代码并指导运行。

say.text: 部署一个文本生成模型为 API，使用 A10G GPU。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write Python code to run ML workloads on Modal's serverless GPU platform, such as deploying models as APIs, running batch inference, or scheduled jobs, without managing infrastructure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need on-demand GPU access for ML workloads like deploying models as APIs, running batch jobs, or scheduled tasks, without infrastructure management.

say_en.text: Write a Modal function that runs nvidia-smi on a T4 GPU.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Python code and guide you to run it.

say_en.text: Deploy a text generation model as an API using an A10G GPU.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code for a Modal app with a web endpoint.
